title: heap overflow in statDecodePage free-chain walk; needs DBSTAT_VTAB
live_proof: fuzz-corpus diff: the image reproduces on stock 3.22.0 under host ASan as heap-buffer-overflow in statDecodePage at sqlite3.c:177925
object: the page buffer statDecodePage walks while following the free-block chain

fidelity: real consumer, real allocator, with a reconstructed trigger (see case 34). Needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB. Distinct from case 38: the same function, a different walk -- the free-chain traversal rather than the cell-pointer array
